meta.title: Awarding more than the line's quantity across vendors is refused when partial awarding is on
gaps: The plan does not verify that the original 25-unit allocations remain unchanged after the rejection.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot select bid with more than requested quantity.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Awarding more than the line's quantity across vendors is refused when partial awarding is on
